maya: Heads-up  opened PR to tighten examples around streaming resume + minimal retry patterns. Looking to keep snippets < 8 lines each. Feedback welcome.
eli: Will review. Can you include both a tiny Python and TS reconnect example? Keep the Go one extra short.
sana: Quick note: our docs use both 'resume token' and 'cursor' in different places; suggest we pick 'resume token' everywhere and add a parenthetical once.
ben: +1 on standardizing. Also add a one-liner about not assuming tokens are sequential (they're opaque).
maya: Agreed. Current draft uses `resume_token` in frontmatter and adds a short blurb: "resume token (opaque server-provided marker)".
deploy-bot: Preview build created: https://deployments.redwood.dev/docs/pr-4592 (build 3)
eli: Found a small bug in the TS example where we re-await the async iterator incorrectly. Here's a compact pattern I prefer:
```ts
// stateless resume: pass last token on reconnect
const stream = client.stream({ conversationId, resumeToken: lastToken });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  handle(chunk);
  lastToken = chunk.resumeToken; // persist outside loop
}
```
Wrap with a retry helper when calling `client.stream` to handle transient network errors.
sana: For Python, keep it equally compact and show periodic checkpointing: 
```py
with client.stream(convo_id, resume_token=tok) as s:
  for i, chunk in enumerate(s):
    process(chunk)
    if i % 10 == 0:
      save(tok := chunk.resume_token)
```
This shows saving every 10 chunks.
ben: Go should show a cookie-cutter: open stream, loop, write token to file on exit. Short.
maya: Good. Also added a bullets section: - resume: stateless vs checkpoint - retries: exponential backoff + idempotency note - naming: use "resume token" consistently.
eli: Tiny nit: change "idempotency" line to say "prefer idempotent ops when replaying requests".
sana: Also flagged a broken link to /guides/streaming (should be /guides/streaming/resume). Left a comment.
deploy-bot: Docs preview updated: https://deployments.redwood.dev/docs/pr-4592 (build 5)
ben: I pushed a one-line Go example and fixed the link in the YAML.
eli: LGTY after we add the TS retry wrapper and the idempotency wording.
maya: Added a 5-line TS retry helper and adjusted the idempotency sentence.
sana: LGTM. No more comments.
maya: Merging shortly unless anyone objects.
eli: fine from me.
ben: Merge away.
maya: Merged. Thanks all! :party_parrot:
